data.value: A type cannot be deleted while Metaverse Objects of it exist. Delete those objects first (stop the source flows and let them deprovision, or delete them manually), then delete the type.

data.value: Remove these Synchronisation Rules first; deleting the type would otherwise remove the whole rule.

data.name: DeleteAttributeReadersBody
data.value: Change or remove each one first, then delete. JIM does not remove them for you: a Scoping Criterion removed from a Synchronisation Rule changes which objects the rule manages.
